defects.description: The candidate contains large blocks of English explanatory notes, drafts and meta‑text (e.g., "Draft 1:", "Sentence 2:", "Check specific word:") that are not part of the source and should not appear in the translation.
defects.quote: Draft 1: Шлюз `pre_check` представляет собой проверку целостности артефактов документации до фиксации переходов состояний протокола.

defects.description: Many source headings and sentences are left untranslated or only partially translated (e.g., "Scope and Enforcement Point", "Verdict Logic", "Documenter Unavailable — Override Mode").
Required glossary term "Session" is not translated; the source phrase "current session" remains untranslated.
Required glossary term "Scenario" is not translated; the source phrase "active scenario" remains untranslated.
Required glossary term "Phase" is not translated; occurrences such as "Phase boundary transition" and "Phase transition" are left in English.
Required glossary term "Moderator" is not translated; the source word "moderator" appears in English.
Required glossary term "Consensus" is not translated; the source phrase "consensus check" remains in English.
Required glossary term "Finding" is not translated; the source phrase "high/critical findings" is left in English.
Required glossary term "Escalation" is not translated; the source phrase "escalation integrity gates" remains in English.
Required glossary term "Artifact" is not translated; the source word "artifacts" (documentation artifacts) is left in English.
Required glossary term "Resolution" is not translated; the source word "Resolution" appears in English.
Code token `audit(pre_check=true)` is correctly preserved, but surrounding text adds an English possessive "Documenter's" which is not translated and breaks the natural Russian phrasing.
The translation mixes Russian and English within the same sentence, resulting in poor fluency (e.g., "Layer 2 (operator surface) as a synchronous call to Документатор's `audit(pre_check=true)`").
